paragraphs.source_en: On Tokugawa Ieyasu’s orders, Ōtani Gyōbu-shōyū Yoshitsugu set out from Tsuruga in Echizen with more than a thousand soldiers on the twenty-ninth day of the sixth month of Keichō 5. Traveling from dawn and lodging each night, he reached Tarui in Mino on the second day of the seventh month and waited there for Ishida Mitsunari’s son, Hayato-no-shō Shigeie.
